lastRequest: Build a fullstack Kanban Task & Project Management web application with drag-and-drop task columns (To Do, In Progress, Done), priority badges, team assignment modals, filter by status, and dark mode UI.

tasks.title: Database Schema Definition
tasks.description: Initialize Prisma and define PostgreSQL schema for User, Board, Column, Task, and Priority entities.

tasks.title: Auth and Backend API Implementation
tasks.description: Configure Express JWT Auth.js and implement React API Routes for CRUD operations on tasks and boards.

tasks.title: State Management and Data Fetching
tasks.description: Implement React Query and Zustand store to synchronize client-side state with server API endpoints.

tasks.title: Kanban UI Construction
tasks.description: Develop board interface, drag-and-drop interactions using dnd-kit, and theme toggling with next-themes.

tasks.title: Forms and Filtering Logic
tasks.description: Implement task creation/edit modals with Zod validation and reactive filtering features.
